title: round
description: One round of an experiment (ADR-0004), optional: what it set out to learn, what changed against the round before, the arms it dropped and why, the baseline it started from, and what it concluded. data/rounds/<goal_id>/<round_id>.yaml, written by evh round-open / round-retire / round-close. Its arms are the configs whose runs name it (`round:` in the config, recorded on the run).

round_id.description: r1, r2, ...: equals the file name.

dataset_id.description: The dataset its arms run on.

hypothesis.description: What the round sets out to learn, in a sentence.

changes.description: What changed against `from`, and why, one line each.

baseline.description: The run it starts from and is measured against: the dataset's promoted baseline when it opened.

carried.description: Config ids from earlier rounds kept in this one unchanged, compared without being run again.

budget_usd.description: What the round may spend; its billed cost is shown against it.
